According to the binomial nomenclature system, the first name represents the **genus** (capitalized) and the second represents the **species** (lowercase), with both italicized.

| No. | Scientific Name | Habitat / Where Found | Kingdom |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | 
| 1. | *Escherichia coli* | Lower intestine of warm-blooded organisms | Monera |
| 2. | *Saccharomyces cerevisiae* | Surfaces of fruits and plant leaves (Brewery/Bakery) | Fungi |
| 3. | *Lactobacillus acidophilus* | Human gut and dairy products | Monera |
| 4. | *Aspergillus niger* | Soil, decaying organic matter, and food surfaces | Fungi |
| 5. | *Penicillium chrysogenum* | Soil and rotting vegetation | Fungi |
proTip: Never forget to capitalize only the genus name and italicize/underline both genus and species names.
